items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I think he left with Tommy Ladnier Latin, or Booker Miley, or something, went to Europe.

ctx.x: Then, after Blanch Calloway had come to New York, through Chicago and all that, then Booker left, and I think he left with Tommy Ladnier Latin, or Booker Miley, or something, went to Europe.
And he stayed over in Europe --
